name: Superman
description: Strengthens the back of the body: lying face down with arms overhead, lift your arms, chest and legs a little way off the floor.

source.title: Supermans (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front of you.
cues: Lift only a few centimetres; it's not a backbend.
Keep your neck long, looking at the floor.
Squeeze your glutes as your legs lift.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Lift
keyframes.cue: Raise your arms, chest and legs.
